about: The first Dancer dwelling (add-settlement-economy: a cottage houses at most four): an off-grid homestead of rammed earth, salvaged timber and a living sod roof, with one great grown-wood rib sweeping from the ridge to the ground; graphene solar on titanium rails, a vertical-axis turbine, a caged rain tank with a filter column, a battery cabinet, a stovepipe and a reed-shaded porch. Brief: docs/art/cottage.md.

lights.Cottage_Window: the windows' amber glow (emissive, authored at peak); the game may dim it by day and light it at night

acoustics.about: near-level meshes carry glTF extras {"acoustic": <preset>}; small trim, clutter and the turbine blades are left out
